transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi, yes, I do have a few questions. First of all, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise, like gardening, after 1 week. Try to avoid heavy lifting or strenuous work for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide some more.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Perfect, I appreciate it. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as your eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s only mild and things just seem brighter, wear sunglasses when you go outside.

But if it’s severe, or you have strong pain, or your eye is red and painful, that is not normal and may need a check.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for the advice. Should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it is still blurry, or getting more blurry, we may need to check it.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all for now. Thank you for answering my questions!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, everything's been answered. Thank you for your help!

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "A bit of light sensitivity can be normal as your eye adjusts to the new lens." The `mild_case_advice` was also conveyed in the same turn: "If it’s only mild and things just seem brighter, wear sunglasses when you go outside." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered by "But if it’s severe, or you have strong pain, or your eye is red and painful, that is not normal and may need a check."
